item.text:
This turn added one more canonical Raft safety check.

**New: direct Log Matching Property assertion.** The randomized test now also reads every node's `LogStore` and verifies that any two logs agree at every shared index (same term/type/data), including the uncommitted tail — distinct from FSM-apply equality and from `EnsureSame`.

Result: **PASS** non-race (2/2, ~70 acked commands each) and **PASS under `-race`** with no data race (log `logs/audit_randomized.log`).

**Final audit status — no concrete correctness defect found.** The captured implementation is the unmodified upstream `hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3 (`c0dc6a0b`), verified byte-for-byte against the sumdb-backed module cache. Supporting evidence, all executed: full suite passes except socket-blocked TCP tests; full suite under `-race` shows zero races; `gofmt`/`go vet` clean; and four independent audit checks (in-memory crash/restart convergence, randomized acknowledged-entry safety plus Log Matching Property, and the socketless `net.Pipe` transport harness) all pass, including under `-race`. The consensus core and transport layer were also read line-by-line against the spec with no deviation.

**Caveats recorded (not defects):** `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange` flakes under `-race` due to a test-timing wait (≈2/40), and the literal TCP tests plus the `fuzzy` linearizability module cannot run in this sandbox.

Report: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md); logs in `work/logs/`; diagnostic tests `zz_audit_crash_test.go` and `zz_audit_transport_test.go` in the work copy.
